extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys, IP office examiners, and judges in OAPI member states
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and procedural standards under the Bangui Agreement (OAPI) governing patentability, formal requirements, prosecution, grants, post-grant rights, licences, invalidity/forfeiture, enforcement and remedies for patents (and related instruments such as certificates of addition and utility models) in OAPI member States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentable Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and criteria for what constitutes a patentable invention under the Agreement (heading: 'Patentable Invention').

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention must be new (heading: 'Novelty').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention must involve an inventive step (heading: 'Inventive Step').

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial Applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention must be industrially applicable (heading: 'Industrial Applicability').

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Patentable Subject Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: List/description of subject matter excluded from patent protection (heading: 'Non-Patentable Subject Matter').

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights Conferred by the Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the exclusive rights granted to the patent holder (heading: 'Rights Conferred by the Patent').

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation of the Rights Conferred by the Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory limits and exceptions to patent rights (heading: 'Limitation of the Rights Conferred by the Patent').

rubrics_metrics.name: Term of Protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Length/duration of patent protection (heading: 'Term of Protection').

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to the Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on entitlement to apply for and hold a patent (heading: 'Right to the Patent').

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to the Patent: Employee Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules governing inventions made by employees (heading: 'Right to the Patent: Employee Inventions').

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of a Patent Application into a Utility Model Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural right to convert a pending patent application into a utility model application (heading: 'Conversion of a Patent Application into a Utility Model Application').

rubrics_metrics.name: Right of Foreigners to Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning entitlement of non-nationals/foreign applicants to patents in OAPI (heading: 'Right of Foreigners to Patents').

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of the Application (formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formalities for filing a patent application (heading: 'Filing of the Application').

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an application relate to a single invention or to a group of inventions linked so as to form a single inventive concept (heading: 'Unity of Invention').

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim of Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Right and formal requirements to claim priority from earlier filings (heading: 'Claim of Priority').

rubrics_metrics.name: Unacceptability Due to Non-Payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds for deeming an application unacceptable if required fees are not paid (heading: 'Unacceptability Due to Non-Payment').

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for determining the filing date of an application (heading: 'Filing Date').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal of the Patent Application to OAPI
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and timing for transmitting national applications to the Organization (heading: 'Transmittal of the Patent Application to OAPI').

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive and/or formal examination procedures applied to patent applications (heading: 'Examination of Applications').

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of the Claims, the Description, the Drawings and the Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and procedures for amending claims, specification, drawings and abstract during prosecution (heading: 'Amendment of the Claims, the Description, the Drawings and the Abstract').

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and formal steps for grant of a patent (heading: 'Grant').

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferment of Grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules allowing the deferment/suspension of the grant of a patent (heading: 'Deferment of Grant').

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions Governing Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds and procedure for rejecting an application (heading: 'Conditions Governing Rejection').

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording of Acts in the Special Register of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Which acts must be recorded in the special patent register and the legal effects of recording (heading: 'Recording of Acts in the Special Register of Patents').

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates of Addition
rubrics_metrics.description: Right to certificates of addition, their duration and conversion into patents (heading: 'Certificates of Addition').

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication of Descriptions and Drawings; Publication of Patents and Certificates of Addition
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for disclosure/communication of patent descriptions/drawings and publication procedures (heading: 'Communication of Descriptions and Drawings of Patents and Certificates of Addition' and 'Publication').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transfer and Assignment of Rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Formalities and legal effects for transfer/assignment of patent rights (heading: 'Transfer and Assignment of Rights').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC notes recording and publication in the special register for enforceability against third parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforceability Against Third Parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Condition that transfers/licenses be recorded to be binding on third parties (heading: 'Enforceability Against Third Parties').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Agreement indicates recording/registration in the special register is necessary for third‑party enforceability; publication by the Organization is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploitation of the Patent and its Certificates of Addition as of Right
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope of acts that patent owner may do 'as of right' and limits on exploitation (heading: 'Exploitation of the Patent and its Certificates of Addition as of Right').

rubrics_metrics.name: License Contracts (form and content); Invalid Clauses; Recognition of Invalid Clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for licensing agreements, prohibited/invalid clauses and the legal recognition of invalid clauses (heading: 'License Contract' and 'Invalid Clauses' and 'Recognition of Invalid Clauses').

rubrics_metrics.name: Invalidity
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds and effects for judicial invalidation of a patent (heading: 'Invalidity').

rubrics_metrics.name: Forfeiture
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds and procedures by which the Organization may deprive an owner of a patent (heading: 'Forfeiture').

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoration (of rights after failure to comply)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and timing under which protection (e.g., certificates/rights) may be restored after lapse (appears for plant varieties and analogous remedies may exist for patents; heading: 'Restoration').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For plant variety certificates Article 35 provides a model: restoration on payment of fees and restoration fee within six months from when reasons ceased and at latest two years from date renewal was due; Organization examines reasons; restoration does not prolong the term and published; decisions appealable within 30 days. Similar procedural logic may apply to other titles where restoration provisions appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions Seeking Invalidity or Forfeiture: Initiation and Competent Jurisdiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Who may initiate proceedings for invalidity/forfeiture, applicable jurisdiction and recording of judicial decisions (heading: 'Actions Seeking Invalidity or Forfeiture', 'Initiation of the Invalidity or Forfeiture Action', 'Competent Jurisdiction', 'Recording of the Judicial Decision on Invalidity or Forfeiture').

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Voluntary Licences (for Non-Working)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and procedures for granting non-voluntary licences where patent is not worked (heading: 'Non-Voluntary License for Non-Working').

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Voluntary Licence for a Dependent Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for compulsory licensing when exploitation requires use of another patent (heading: 'Non-Voluntary License for a Dependent Patent').

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for the Grant of a Non-Voluntary License; Grant; Rights and Obligations of the Holder of a Non-Voluntary License
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps to request compulsory licences, grounds for grant and the rights/obligations that flow to licensee (headings: 'Request for the Grant of a Non-Voluntary License', 'Grant of Non-Voluntary License', 'Rights and Obligations of the Holder of a Non-Voluntary License').

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation of the Non-Voluntary License; Amendment and Withdrawal
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope limits, duration limits, and procedures for amending or withdrawing a non-voluntary licence (headings: 'Limitation of the Non-Voluntary License', 'Amendment and Withdrawal of the Non-Voluntary License').

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals from Decisions of the Organization/Administrative Bodies
rubrics_metrics.description: Appeal routes and time limits (e.g., appeals to the High Commission of Appeal; TOC entries 'Appeals', 'High Commission of Appeal').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: For restoration of plant variety certificates decisions of the Organization are appealable to the High Commission of Appeal within 30 days of notification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex-Officio Licenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for licenses imposed ex-officio by authorities (heading: 'Ex-Officio Licenses').

rubrics_metrics.name: Licenses of Right
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanism and consequences for designating patents as 'licenses of right' and the resulting public availability to licensees (heading: 'Licenses of Right').

rubrics_metrics.name: Defense of Rights Granted; Civil Remedies
rubrics_metrics.description: Civil procedures and remedies available to patent owners to defend their rights (heading: 'Defense of Rights Granted').

rubrics_metrics.name: Infringement (acts constituting infringement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of acts which, when carried out without consent, constitute patent infringement (heading: 'Infringement').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For plant variety certificates (analogous) Article 43(1) states that any of the acts referred to in Article 29 carried out on the territory of a member State by a person other than the owner and without his consent constitutes an infringement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recidivism and Aggravating Circumstances; Extenuating Circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration of repeat offenses and factors increasing or decreasing sanctions (headings: 'Recidivism and Aggravating Circumstances', 'Extenuating Circumstances').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Agreement references application of domestic law provisions on extenuating circumstances and enhanced penalties for recidivists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Condition for Initiation of Criminal Proceedings; Exceptional Competence of the Criminal Court
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions under which criminal proceedings may be initiated and competence of criminal courts for patent-related offenses (headings: 'Condition for Initiation of Criminal Proceedings', 'Exceptional Competence of the Criminal Court').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For plant varieties Article 49 makes correctional proceedings possible on a complaint by the injured party; criminal penalties and special competence are addressed in the TOC and in Articles covering penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acts Prior to Grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of acts committed before grant of the patent and whether they constitute infringement or are actionable (heading: 'Acts Prior to Grant').

rubrics_metrics.name: Infringement Seizure (pre-trial remedies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for ordering seizure/description of allegedly infringing items, who may order it, conditions and security deposit (heading: 'Infringement Seizure').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article 44 (plant variety context) details: order from presiding judge by simple request on presentation of certificate and proof not invalidated; possible deposit of security before operation; security required for foreigners; copy of order must be given to holder on pain of nullity and damages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time Limit for Initiating Substantive Proceedings After Seizure
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline for instituting civil or criminal proceedings after seizure/description (heading: 'Time Limit for Initiating Substantive Proceedings').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article 45 (plant varieties) states petitioner must institute proceedings within ten working days from seizure/description or seizure becomes null and void, without prejudice to damages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Burden of Proof
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocation of the burden of proof in infringement or other patent-related proceedings (heading: 'Burden of Proof').

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Sanctions (confiscation, destruction, fines, imprisonment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Available sanctions for infringement including fines, imprisonment, confiscation, destruction, publicizing sentence and auctioning confiscated items (headings: 'Other Sanctions', 'Penalties').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article 46 (plant varieties) lists confiscation, destruction or handing items to owner, confiscation of devices used to perpetrate infringement; sale by auction for benefit of the State; publicizing sentence as an option.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usurpation (improperly assuming owner status)
rubrics_metrics.description: Penalty for improperly availing oneself of status of owner of a certificate or application (heading: 'Usurpation').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article 47 (plant varieties) imposes fines and doubled fines on repetition; analogous protections exist for patent ownership claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions for Extension of Procedural Time Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules allowing the Organization to extend prescribed time limits on request and on conditions, including after expiry (heading: 'Extension of Time Limits').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article 42 provides that Organization may extend time limits on written request and may grant extensions even if the time limit has expired, subject to specified conditions and notification to parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording and Publication of Decisions Affecting Rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to record invalidation, forfeiture, transfers, licences and restoration in the Organization's registers and to publish notices (TOC entries and multiple articles such as recording of invalidity/forfeiture and publishing restoration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple provisions specify that changes of ownership, invalidations, forfeitures, restoration and licences must be registered and published to have effect against third parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion Between Patent, Utility Model and Improvement Certificate
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures allowing conversion of applications between patents, utility models and improvement certificates, and vice versa (headings: 'Conversion of a Patent Application into a Utility Model Application', 'Conversion of an Application for a Certificate of Addition into a Patent Application', 'Conversion of an Application for an Improvement Certificate into an Application for a Certificate of Registration of a Utility Model').
